verdict.rationale: Texas SOS documents that filers can "check status and retrieve filings from the My Submissions page" in SOSPortal, and the public homepage links to "Track Business Filings". However, My Submissions sits inside an account-based portal with multi-factor authentication, and the tracking link is only a label, with no description of how public lookup works. Missing for 10: documented public status lookup without login, details of what the Track Business Filings feature shows, status coverage beyond business filings (applications or cases), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Ability to check status and retrieve filings from the My Submissions page
